title: exampleLoops
one_liner: Educational code samples demonstrating basic loop structures in Java and Python.
what_it_is: A minimal educational repository containing implementations of a simple multiplication table generator. It solves a specific algorithmic task: given an integer n, print the first 10 multiples of n using iterative loops. The project serves as a reference for syntax comparison between Java and Python.
how_its_built: The Java implementation uses the java.util.Scanner class for standard input parsing and a standard for-loop for iteration. The logic calculates products sequentially and prints formatted strings to stdout. The Python implementation (implied by description) follows similar logic using Python's range-based looping constructs.
how_to_apply: Use this repository as a baseline for teaching introductory programming concepts, specifically iteration and standard I/O. It is suitable for beginners learning syntax differences between statically typed (Java) and dynamically typed (Python) languages.
quickstart:
javac Solution.java
java Solution
python3 loops.py
features: Reads an integer from standard input
Iterates exactly 10 times using a counter
Formats output as 'n x i = result'
Demonstrates basic loop syntax in Java
